requirements.statement: Freeze successor contract and bootstrap trust island on an isolated branch; persist plan hash and BOOTSTRAP_UNCERTIFIED envelope with separated identities; no PASS claim at bootstrap.

Unified closure service: mandatory gates reject empty requirements/reconciliation/evidence and unresolved requirements; four-identity evidence binding; behavioral baseline B + allowlisted metadata commit C + exact-SHA attestation; prepare/stage/commit single-point transaction with idempotent replay; invalid v1 closure corrected to SUPERSEDED/INACTIVE with terminal PARTIAL; operational state ignored in consumer worktrees.
Release completion: exact package install, G1-G4 generic fixtures, exact-SHA CI green, terminal closure idempotent and atomically deactivated.
Terminality: generic consumer tasks must not stop at code complete; compiled lifecycle stages enforced.
Evidence binding: every receipt binds harness release, installation/projection, consumer candidate and host runtime; cross-repo replay rejects.
Artifacts: operational state ignored/out-of-source on arbitrary worktrees; fresh repos remain source-clean.

note: Superseded by terminal-harness-convergence-v1 (AM-0001). Terminally invalid: old 'PASS' reports were not terminal truth; 21 source requirements remained pending and reconciliation was empty. Classified SUPERSEDED/INACTIVE/PARTIAL, never flipped to PASS.
